plan: Given my value of $30, I aim to win while ensuring a profit. Bidding too high risks overpaying, while bidding too low risks losing. Assuming others bid near their values, I'll bid slightly above average, around $25, to outbid lower bids and still profit if I win. The third-highest bid is likely close to the lowest bid, minimizing my cost.
